time_units: All bar times are UTC epoch milliseconds. Binance close_time = open_time + bar_ms - 1. Decision boundary (judgement instant) = open_time + bar_ms.

technical_cross.strong_full_cross: ema_squeeze_rules.full_cross:30-40: current EMA7>EMA25>EMA99 (strict) AND prev EMA25<=EMA99 (equality allowed on prev; equality on current fails)
technical_cross.medium_cross: ema_squeeze_rules.medium_cross:43-52: prev EMA7<=EMA25 AND current EMA7>EMA25 AND close>EMA99 (strict)
technical_cross.precedence: ema_event_timing.py:93 level = strong if fullCross else medium if mediumCrossEvent
technical_cross.weak_label: scanner.py:199-200 grade 'weak' = priceAboveEma99 (close>EMA99) AND ema7Below25 (EMA7<EMA25); scanner.py:448 riskFlag '弱穿线…勿当入场'. Label only, never a cross event, never upgraded (see tracking profile A.weak_scope)
technical_cross.warmup: scanner.py:165-187: <120 bars insufficient; at exactly 120 bars fullCross/mediumCrossEvent=None (prev state unproven)

volume_confirm.ratio: VOL_CONFIRM_RATIO = 2.0; vol_ratio7 = bar quote volume / mean(prior 7 bars), denominator excludes the bar (scanner.py:188-190, ema_observations.py:58-62); >= 2.0 passes (equality passes)
volume_confirm.window: T (cross bar, if vol>=2 on T) OR the real next bar T+1 only (bar - cross == 14_400_000); no T+2 window
volume_confirm.t1_order: ema_event_timing.py:76-91 at T+1: gap_missing_next_bar -> next_bar_structure_unknown -> structure_broken -> next_bar_volume_unknown -> next_bar_oi_unknown (non-historical) -> next_bar_volume_fail (<2) -> confirmed
volume_confirm.on_t1_still_fail: void that cross event (terminal); later volume is progress only, never back-filled confirm
volume_confirm.progress_definition: progress_offsets = offsets (in 4H bars from T) of bars strictly AFTER the bar that resolved the event (T, T+1, or the bar that exposed the gap) where vol_ratio7 newly reaches >= 2.0 after a bar below 2.0; the resolving bar itself is never counted; progress is observation only

technical.event_volume_ratio: q_h / mean(q[h-168..h-1]) >= 8.0; window + h must be 168 contiguous 1h bars (b_accumulation_rules.volume_ratio:50-83); else unknown
technical.confirm_h1_volume_ratio: q_{h+1} / mean(q[h+1-168..h]) >= 2.0 (window includes h) on the REAL h+1 only

clocks.h_close: t_h = h.open_time + 3_600_000 (the real hourly close of h)
clocks.h1_close: t_h1 = t_h + 3_600_000 (the real hourly close of h+1); evaluated only when t_h1 <= target_close_boundary, else pending
clocks.structure_at_h: structure(t_h) -> b_evidence.structure_at(t_h): OI and LSR picked at t_h, NOT at a 4H boundary
clocks.combined: combine_tri(structure_h, structure_h1) (fail first); while h+1 is open: fail if structure_h fail else pending
clocks.background_at_h: background(t_h) = latest CLOSED 4H whose close boundary == floor(t_h / 4H) * 4H (b_evidence.background_at:12-26); EMA7>EMA25 strict; requires >=120 contiguous 4H rows
clocks.background_at_h1: background(t_h1), selected independently; when h+1 closes on a 4H boundary (e.g. 08:00) it is a DIFFERENT 4H bar than background(t_h)
clocks.r0_error_fixed: r0 wrote 'contemporaneous_with = closed 4H boundary' (S1-P1-01). That was wrong: the OI/LSR clock is the hourly close of h / h+1; only the EMA background uses the latest closed 4H.

structure_qualification.sample_pick: b_contemporaneous.pick_sample_at_or_before:25-49: latest sample with timestamp <= t; quality pass iff 0 <= t - s <= 300000 ms; s > t ignored; stale -> quality 'fail'
structure_qualification.quality_to_state: b_evidence.structure_at:28-30: any non-pass OI/LSR quality -> 'unknown' (never an economic fail)
structure_qualification.effective_at: sample 'timestamp' field of the Binance 1h OI / account-LSR row (oi_source_period='1h', b_evidence.py:55)
structure_qualification.available_at: system retrieved_at of that sample; stored separately; NOT used to decide contemporaneity (1015 §5.1: contemporaneous != available at that time)
structure_qualification.cap: capTrusted is True AND 0 <= t - capObservedAt <= 3_600_000 AND capUsd finite > 0 (b_evidence.py:31-35); same cap record checked separately against t_h and t_h1
structure_qualification.per_point_record: each of h and h+1 stores its own {boundary_ms, oi_sample_ts, oi_delta_ms, lsr_sample_ts, lsr_delta_ms, cap quality, state} (b_evidence.py:55 source_boundary/oi_delta_ms/lsr_delta_ms)

clock.timeframe: 4h closed bars; T0 = open_time of the C0 bar; T+k = the bar whose open = T0 + k*14_400_000
clock.lifetime_end: T0 + 11*14_400_000 (close of real T+10), fixed at C0; missing data never pauses or extends it (1015 §3.3 line 59, §6 item 7 line 127)

C0.below_all_ema: close strictly below EMA7, EMA25, EMA99 (equality fails)
C0.strict_new_lows_14: <=2; 14 consecutive real closes ending at the bar; first = baseline; strict < min(previous) counts; any missing bar -> unknown
C0.tri_state: fail first, unknown second; only all-pass forms C0

C1.window: T+1..T+10 inclusive (never T0); T+11 never confirms the old cycle
C1.volume: confirm bar quote vol / mean(prior 7 real consecutive 4H) > 3 (STRICT; exactly 3.0 fails) AND close > open (doji fails); zero/short baseline -> unknown

invalidation_expiry_rearm.per_bar_order: 1) explicit invalidation  2) valid confirmation  3) at T+10 only: expiry_10_bars
invalidation_expiry_rearm.two_adjacent_closed_4h_lsr_ge_1_5: invalidate only if BOTH real adjacent bars exist and both LSR valid >= 1.5; a missing candle/LSR is UNPROVABLE, not a proof of non-adjacency: the pair is proven absent only when one real side is < 1.5 (1.6 -> 1.4 -> 1.7 is not); 1.6 -> missing -> any is UNRESOLVED and must be replayed from that root once the value arrives (1.6 -> 1.7 invalidates at that root)
invalidation_expiry_rearm.unresolved_root_rule: (S1-R1-P1-01) a root is RESOLVED when invalidation is proven yes, or proven no AND confirmation is proven pass/fail; otherwise UNRESOLVED (missing candle, missing OI/LSR/volume baseline/new-low window that can still change the root). Later roots may record LOCAL technical facts, but formal confirmation / invalidation / notify_live / continuity watermark must not advance past the earliest unresolved root; the cycle stays waiting (partially_unverified) until backfill replays from that root. A missing input on a root whose outcome is already proven (e.g. bearish candle => confirmation fail and the other side of the LSR pair < 1.5) does NOT block. The fixed T+10 lifetime is unaffected: at T+10 with an unresolved root the cycle expires with partially_unverified=true; a late backfill appends a historical late_backfill revision (never live, never extends)
invalidation_expiry_rearm.expiry_reason: primary expiry_10_bars; secondary missing_candles / missing_oi / missing_lsr / missing_volume_baseline; partially_unverified=true when any
invalidation_expiry_rearm.late_backfill: after expiry, a backfilled bar that would have confirmed/invalidated creates revision 2 (historical, discovery=late_backfill, notify_live=false) linked to revision 1; revision 1 retained; lifetime_end unchanged
invalidation_expiry_rearm.rearm: after a terminal state a full C0 explicit 'fail' must be observed, then 'pass'; 'unknown' never completes the step; new cycle gets a new identity
